note: Trailer 2 from Rockstar's own media server (the brief named IGN; Rockstar is the primary and the file is 4K, so no enlargement). Track 25.6 s for 19.0 s: the trailer's own sound, speech none (speechcheck --stretch 25.6 19.0, both ends in a pause). Shots (split per editor decision b; each over 4.0 s now two halves): 26.0 shirtless man at a door (headline hook, the strongest figure, clear of the ESRB card at 0 s); 44.0 man in shorts at a shop door, centred (L1); 37.5 Vice City airport signs and a plane (L2, place shot); 48.0 police car at night, driver in frame (L3); 29.0 driver at the wheel (L4, payoff). Shots are not from the 15 Oct launch trailer file. Lines: outlet-report facts (PS5 midnight local, Xbox midnight GMT, up to 212 GB) are labelled in the text; NZ not claimed. Open for the editor: L1 names the company without a bracket (rule: the first on-screen mention takes «(Rockstar Games)»); L3 opens on و and continues L2 (rule: within 3 s); the headline has the Latin GTA VI first word-run after an Arabic word. v2 (director FIX on v1, story director_qa, 91dc0f5): track is our bed (vocal song in both trailers); shot 1 is 50.0 s instead of 44.0 s.
